(a) No retry cap in the SyncManager (MAX_RETRIES removed): transient failures (no status, 5xx, 401, 408, 425, 429) back off 30 s doubling to 15 min and are retried until accepted; a permanent 4xx parks the entry as 'not sent' (kept; the AppOfflineBanner names it with Try again / Discard), never deleted; one flush at a time across tabs (navigator.locks). (c) logout() flushes, then window.confirm(signOutWarning(n)) with the exact count sign-out would remove; on confirm it clears that person's changes in every house plus legacy entries naming no one (a legacy door receipt stays with its house); a refused refresh (endSession) keeps the queue for the same person's next sign-in.
